partners.mechanism_chain: Activating TSHR variant (rs775735206) —DISRUPTS→ TSHR (HGNC:11771); TSHR (HGNC:11771) —INCREASES→ cAMP-PKA pathway activation (GO:0007253); cAMP-PKA pathway activation (GO:0007253) —LEADS_TO→ Hyperthyroidism (HP:0000835); Loss-of-function GNRH1 variant (rs775735207) —DISRUPTS→ GNRH1 (HGNC:4323); GNRH1 (HGNC:4323) —DECREASES→ GnRH signaling pathway (GO:0007243); GnRH signaling pathway (GO:0007243) —LEADS_TO→ Hypogonadotropic hypogonadism (HP:0000831); GnRH signaling pathway (GO:0007243) —LEADS_TO→ Anosmia (HP:0000371).
